guide.title: Bird Bend Stand — board bring-up guide
guide.content_version: 1.4 (A, guide draft 0.4; + SWD-P3-03 mismatch FAILs, SWD-P3-06 buffer-board verdict, E R-1, 2026-10-14)

send_to: Send this zip file to the product owner (e-mail), with the photos of section 13 if they are not attached.

sections.title: 3 Wiring check with all power OFF
8 48 V on: driver power, ENABLE / DISABLE, D-42 ENA cut

steps.title: E-stop is not IEC 60204-1
steps.instruction: The red E-stop stops the pulses and cuts ENA directly (D-42) but the 48 V stays on; the only power removal is the 48 V PSU mains switch. Keep both within reach whenever the 48 V is on.
steps.safety: The red E-stop stops the pulses and cuts ENA directly (D-42) but the 48 V stays on; the only power removal is the 48 V PSU mains switch. Keep both within reach whenever the 48 V is on.

steps.title: Two persons
steps.instruction: Whenever the driver is powered: the operator at the PC and the observer at the operator panel, a hand near the red button and the PSU switch.

steps.title: No specimen, no load
steps.instruction: No specimen, no load on the table, no tool in the travel for the whole bring-up. The only load: the calibration weights in section 11, axis still and PAUSED.

steps.title: Hands clear
steps.instruction: Hands clear of screw, table and load path while the driver is powered. Touch the coupling only where a step asks, after 'hands off the mouse'. Hands off the shaft before the E-stop / RESET is released and before any Clear / ENABLE (the closed-loop driver re-energises at once).
steps.safety: Hands clear of screw, table and load path while the driver is powered. Touch the coupling only where a step asks, after 'hands off the mouse'. Hands off the shaft before the E-stop / RESET is released and before any Clear / ENABLE (the closed-loop driver re-energises at once).

steps.title: First motion slow
steps.instruction: Jogs at 1 mm/s, homing at the FW homing speed, every Go to at 5 mm/s (never above 10 mm/s). Only exception: the pulse-integrity check 10.2 at 30 mm/s.

steps.title: Never bypass the E-stop sense
steps.instruction: No jumper, no stimulus, no unplugged sense connector while the driver is powered (HW gate only).

steps.title: Abort criteria
steps.instruction: Unexpected motion, noise, smell, ALM red with 48 V on, table outside the expected position → observer presses the red E-stop at once and switches the PSU off; operator releases any jog button and presses STOP; incident note.
steps.safety: Unexpected motion, noise, smell, ALM red with 48 V on, table outside the expected position → observer presses the red E-stop at once and switches the PSU off; operator releases any jog button and presses STOP; incident note.

steps.title: Wiring changes only with everything off
steps.instruction: PSU mains switch off and Nucleo USB unplugged; DIP switches only with the driver unpowered.

steps.title: No specimen in no-specimen mode
steps.instruction: Never mount a specimen while the amber banner NO-SPECIMEN MODE … is shown.

steps.title: PO release (D-06)
steps.instruction: Start only when the PO has released this board for bring-up (flashing and the COM port need the PO's go). Enter the PO's name and the date of the release.

fields.name: released
fields.label: The PO has released this board for bring-up

steps.title: Multimeter and shunts
steps.instruction: Multimeter (V, mA, Ω, MΩ, diode test), two 100 Ω 1 % shunts, one 10 Ω resistor, clip leads.

steps.title: Caliper and rule
steps.instruction: Caliper 0.02 mm (dial gauge optional); a steel rule for the switch span (3.3).

steps.title: Calibration weights
steps.instruction: Weights 1 kg and 10 kg with a hook / sling for the load cell.

steps.title: Small tools
steps.instruction: Small screwdriver (DIP switches, terminals), cable ties, labels.

steps.title: Camera
steps.instruction: Phone / camera for the photos of section 13.

steps.title: Printouts
steps.instruction: Printed wiring diagram sheets 1–4 and the guide.

steps.title: PC software
steps.instruction: Windows 10/11 PC, free USB port, the PC software of the package (STM32CubeProgrammer only if drag-and-drop fails).

steps.title: Bench built per the diagram
steps.instruction: HX711 RATE wire to PB5 (pin 15 lifted); D-42 E-stop NO contact → +5V_CUT → R_E → D2 → ENA+; operator panel (red E-stop, PAUSE); START / END NC switches. No buffer board (D-56 b).

steps.title: Nucleo solder bridges
steps.instruction: 48 V PSU mains switch off, Nucleo USB unplugged, E-stop released. Solder bridges per sheet 2: SB13, SB14 ON · SB62, SB63 OFF · SB16, SB50 ON · SB54, SB55 OFF · SB51, SB56 ON · SB46, SB52 OFF; JP5 = U5V. Photo of both sides.

steps.title: Nothing on D0 / D1
steps.instruction: Nothing is wired to D0 / D1 (PA3 / PA2 are the PC link).

steps.title: Connections of sheet 2
steps.instruction: Every connection of sheet 2 at the pin given there (compare CN numbers with the silkscreen): PUL A0 · DIR A1 · ENA A2 (through D1) · START A3 · END A4 · ALM D7 · PEND D8 · E-stop sense D2 · PAUSE D10 · DOUT D5 · PD_SCK D6 (33 Ω) · RATE D4.

steps.title: Common cathode
steps.instruction: Driver PUL−, DIR−, ENA−, ALM−, PEND− go to the Nucleo GND (sheet 4).

steps.title: E-stop circuit (D-42)
steps.instruction: NC block → PA10; NO block → +5V_CUT → R_E 68 Ω → D2 → ENA+; D1 between PA4 and ENA+; 10 kΩ ENA+ → GND; no contactor, nothing from the MCU in the NO path; panel label 'not an IEC 60204-1 emergency stop'.

steps.title: +5V_CUT supply
steps.instruction: The +5V_CUT DC-DC is fed from the 48 V bus after F1; F1 = T10A fitted.

steps.title: Cable routing
steps.instruction: Control and load-cell cables ≥ 10 cm from motor / 48 V wires, crossings at 90°.

steps.title: START switch continuity
steps.instruction: START signal wire ↔ GND at the interface connector: switch not touched, then pressed by hand.

steps.title: END switch continuity
steps.instruction: END signal wire ↔ GND: not touched, then pressed.

steps.title: E-stop NC block
steps.instruction: E-stop NC block terminals: released, then pressed.

steps.title: E-stop NO block
steps.instruction: E-stop NO block terminals: released, then pressed.

steps.title: PAUSE contact
steps.instruction: PAUSE contact: released, then pressed.

steps.title: R_E
steps.instruction: Resistance across R_E.

steps.title: D1 / D2 diode test
steps.instruction: Diode test, red probe on the anode (D1: PA4 side; D2: R_E side), then reversed.

steps.title: Isolation 48 V GND ↔ logic GND
steps.instruction: Driver 48 V GND (PSU 0 V) ↔ Nucleo GND, USB unplugged, PSU off. OL → enter 999.
steps.safety: Below 10 MΩ the isolation barrier is bridged — never power the stand like that.

steps.title: Isolation PE ↔ logic GND
steps.instruction: PE (PSU earth terminal) ↔ Nucleo GND, USB unplugged. OL → enter 999.

steps.title: Motor shield to PE
steps.instruction: Motor cable shield ↔ driver PE.

steps.title: Control-cable shield
steps.instruction: Shield ↔ Nucleo GND at the board end; the same shield ↔ driver terminals.
steps.expected: ≈ 0 Ω; open at the driver end

steps.title: Load-cell shield
steps.instruction: Load-cell yellow (shield) ↔ HX711 GND.

steps.title: 48 V wiring
steps.instruction: PSU + → F1 → driver +Vdc; PSU 0 V → driver GND.

steps.title: START margin
steps.instruction: All power off, move the table by hand toward START with the DMM on 3.2-1: the switch must open ≥ 3 mm before any mechanical stop. Enter the remaining distance.

fields.name: margin_start
fields.label: START margin to the mechanical stop

steps.title: END margin
steps.instruction: Same at the END end with 3.2-2: the END switch must open ≥ 5 mm before any mechanical stop.

fields.name: margin_end
fields.label: END margin to the mechanical stop

steps.title: Switch-to-switch span
steps.instruction: Table position where START opens → where END opens.

steps.title: Table near the middle
steps.instruction: Leave the table near the middle (≥ 20 mm from both switches).

steps.title: Driver unpowered
steps.instruction: PSU mains switch off; the driver LEDs are dark.

steps.title: DIP before the change
steps.instruction: Photo of the DIP block before the change; enter SW1…SW8 as found (expected off ON ON ON off ON off off).

steps.title: DIP target (D-27)
steps.instruction: Set SW1 on · SW2 off · SW3 on · SW4 off · SW5 off · SW6 on · SW7 off · SW8 on (4000 p/rev, CCW, assist on, 86-80/86-118 closed loop); enter the positions now set.
steps.expected: on off on off off on off on

steps.title: Photo after
steps.instruction: Photo of the DIP block after the change.

steps.title: Encoder cable
steps.instruction: Motor encoder cable connected to the driver Encoder terminals (closed loop needs it).

steps.title: 48 V stays off
steps.instruction: The 48 V PSU stays OFF for sections 5–7.

steps.title: Initial state
steps.instruction: E-stop released; START / END not actuated; nothing in the travel.

steps.title: USB and COM port
steps.instruction: Plug the Nucleo into the PC; Device Manager → Ports: STLink Virtual COM Port (COMn). Enter COMn.
steps.expected: ST-LINK drive and COM port present

fields.name: drive
fields.label: ST-LINK drive and COM port present

steps.title: Flash the release image
steps.instruction: Check the file hash (FLASHING §5) and flash BBS_FW_0.8.6_release.bin by drag-and-drop (FLASHING method A; wipes the saved configuration on purpose).

steps.title: LD2 after flashing
steps.instruction: Watch the green LED LD2.
steps.expected: slow blink (no latch) or double blink (a latch)
steps.safety: Triple blink = fallback clock (SB16 / SB50) → STOP; dark or steady → STOP.

steps.title: Start the application
steps.instruction: Unzip the PC software to a local folder and start BirdBendStand.exe (it starts disconnected).

steps.title: Connect
steps.instruction: Connection & Config → Endpoint: the Nucleo entry (e.g. 'COM7 STMicroelectronics STLink Virtual COM Port (COM7)') → Connect.

steps.title: Device line (identity)
steps.instruction: Connection & Config: the Device line.
steps.expected: FW 0.8.6, build 20261010-2135, proto 1.0, payload 1, dict hash 0xF8BCDCB8 ✓, UID present, no HW_MEAS; any other value → FAIL (STOP)

steps.title: Version check
steps.instruction: Version check line: ✓ compatible; no RO chip.

steps.title: Link at 80 Hz
steps.instruction: Link line: about 80 Hz samples, no losses growing; LINK chip green CONNECTED.

steps.title: Defaults after the first flash
steps.instruction: Notice 'Board runs on default parameters …' and CFG amber 'dirty NVM defaulted' / 'NVM defaulted' — expected after the first flash (skip with reason if the board already had a saved configuration).

steps.title: Board configuration defaults
steps.instruction: Board configuration table (show advanced): drv.pwr_sense_enable 0, drv.k1_check_enable 0, motion.steps_per_mm 800, afe.rate_sps 80 SPS, drv.alm_active_level HIGH_ACTIVE.
steps.expected: drv.pwr_sense_enable 0, drv.k1_check_enable 0, motion.steps_per_mm 800, afe.rate_sps 80 SPS, drv.alm_active_level HIGH_ACTIVE; any other value → FAIL (STOP)

steps.title: Indicator chips, 48 V off
steps.instruction: Compare the indicator bar with the guide's table (48 V OFF, E-stop released, switches closed). ALM red and THR amber are expected now; KEY red UNAVAILABLE → note it (Tools ▸ Test Pause/Break key…).
steps.expected: no latch, LIM S / LIM E green, AFE green, HOMED red, ENA red, CLK green

steps.title: Load cell sign
steps.instruction: Readouts dock → Raw: pull lightly on the load cell by hand (tension), then push.
steps.expected: Raw increases on pull (a reversed sign is allowed — write it down)

steps.title: E-stop latch
steps.instruction: Press the red E-stop and keep it pressed for more than 1 s.
steps.expected: ESTOP red, only ESTOP latched — no K1_WELDED, no other fault

steps.title: E-stop clear
steps.instruction: Release the button (ESTOP stays red), wait ≥ 100 ms → Clear stop… → tick 'E-stop button released, area safe' → Clear E-STOP.

steps.title: PAUSE button
steps.instruction: Press and release PAUSE once (PAUSED BUTTON, banner 'PAUSED (BUTTON) – motion blocked.'); clear with ▶ Resume, the banner's Resume, or PAUSE again.

steps.title: START switch
steps.instruction: Press the START switch lever by hand, then release it.
steps.expected: LIM S red LIMIT_START, green again after release

steps.title: END switch
steps.instruction: Press the END switch lever by hand, then release it.
steps.expected: LIM E red LIMIT_END, green again after release

steps.title: Wire-break, one connector at a time
steps.instruction: Unplug the START connector, plug it back; then the same with END (one at a time).
steps.expected: LIM S / LIM E red while unplugged (fail-safe), green when plugged

steps.title: Both limit connectors unplugged
steps.instruction: Unplug both limit connectors at once, plug both back → Clear stop… → Clear faults.
steps.expected: LIMIT_WIRING + FAULT, all green after Clear faults

steps.title: ALM with the driver unpowered
steps.instruction: 48 V still off: ALM red 'ALM – new motion blocked' is expected.

steps.title: Board restart
steps.instruction: Press the black RESET button (B2) once (banner 'LINK LOST – reconnecting…' for a moment).
steps.expected: board restarted, link back, ESTOP green

steps.title: 48 V on, motor holds
steps.instruction: Observer switches the 48 V PSU on. The motor holds although ENA says 'disabled' (D-13).
steps.expected: driver power LED on, no alarm LED, motor holds
steps.safety: Two persons: operator at the PC, observer at the red E-stop and the 48 V PSU switch.

fields.name: no_alarm
fields.label: No alarm LED on the driver

steps.title: ALM off with 48 V on
steps.instruction: Watch ALM and PEND after switching the 48 V on.
steps.expected: ALM green OFF within ≈ 1 s; PEND in position

steps.title: E-stop with the board running
steps.instruction: Observer presses the red E-stop → operator (hands off the mouse) turns the coupling: free. Hands off; observer releases → still free. Clear stop… → Clear E-STOP → still free.
steps.expected: free while pressed, after release and after the clear
steps.safety: Hands off the shaft before the E-stop / RESET is released and before any Clear / ENABLE (the closed-loop driver re-energises at once).

steps.title: ENABLE
steps.instruction: Hands off the shaft → Manual tab → tick Driver enabled.
steps.expected: ENA amber ENABLING, then green enabled; the motor holds
steps.safety: Hands off the shaft before the E-stop / RESET is released and before any Clear / ENABLE (the closed-loop driver re-energises at once).

steps.title: DISABLE = free
steps.instruction: E-stop released; untick Driver enabled (dialog 'Disable the driver': tick 'Specimen is unloaded' → Disable); turn the coupling by hand. Then hands off → tick Driver enabled again → holds.
steps.expected: ENA red disabled; the shaft turns freely; holds again after ENABLE
steps.safety: Hands off the mouse while touching the coupling. Hands off the shaft before the E-stop / RESET is released and before any Clear / ENABLE (the closed-loop driver re-energises at once).

all.label: ENA output at the disabled level

fields.name: free
fields.label: The shaft turns freely while disabled

steps.title: D-42 hardwired ENA cut, MCU in reset
steps.instruction: Observer holds RESET (B2) and presses the red E-stop → operator turns the shaft: free. Operator hands off; observer releases the E-stop while still holding RESET → holds again (D-45 a); observer releases RESET → the board restarts.
steps.expected: free with the MCU in reset and the E-stop pressed
steps.hg: ≈ HG-10 c / C-25 (periodic check, D-54 e)
steps.safety: Roles: the observer holds RESET and presses the E-stop, the operator turns the shaft. Hands off the shaft before the E-stop / RESET is released and before any Clear / ENABLE (the closed-loop driver re-energises at once). If the shaft holds with the MCU in reset and the E-stop pressed: STOP — no motion until fixed.

fields.name: free_in_reset
fields.label: Free with the MCU in reset and the E-stop pressed

fields.name: holds_after_release
fields.label: Holds again after the E-stop release (MCU still in reset)

steps.title: DMM on the ENA loop (optional)
steps.instruction: M-1 across R_E (MCU in reset + E-stop pressed); M-3 PA4 (CN8-3); M-4 ENA+ pressed; M-5 +5V_CUT.

steps.title: Driver alarm reset (only if an ALM appeared)
steps.instruction: E-stop → 48 V off, wait until the driver LEDs are dark → 48 V on → release E-stop → Clear E-STOP → Driver enabled → HOME. Skip with reason if no ALM appeared.

steps.title: No-specimen mode
steps.instruction: Safety limits tab → Enter no-specimen mode… → tick No specimen is mounted → Switch PC load limits off.
steps.expected: amber banner NO-SPECIMEN MODE, NOSPEC chip
steps.safety: Never mount a specimen in this mode.

steps.title: Manual tab ready
steps.instruction: Manual tab: Driver enabled ticked; jog speed 1 mm/s.
steps.safety: Unexpected motion → observer presses the red E-stop at once (independent D-42 path); operator releases any jog button and presses STOP; STOP, report.

steps.title: Jog direction
steps.instruction: Zero the caliper. Hold 'hold forward (+) ▶▶' for about 3 s at 1 mm/s, release.
steps.expected: the table moved away from the START switch and stopped on release
steps.safety: Unexpected motion → observer presses the red E-stop at once (independent D-42 path); operator releases any jog button and presses STOP; STOP, report.

steps.title: Scale
steps.instruction: Caliper distance of the jog of 9.3 and the change of Travel (machine).
steps.safety: About 5 × → DIP SW1–SW4 still at 800 p/rev: STOP, 48 V off, section 4.

steps.title: START switch stop, before the first HOME
steps.instruction: Un-homed: hold '◀◀ rear (−) hold' at 1 mm/s until the table reaches the START switch; a further (−) jog must be refused; jog (+) away.
steps.expected: stops at once, LIM S red; (−) refused; (+) clears it (the stop must end the jog: EVENT STOPPED LIMIT_START)
steps.safety: Unexpected motion → observer presses the red E-stop at once (independent D-42 path); operator releases any jog button and presses STOP; STOP, report.

all.label: jog stopped by the START switch

steps.title: HOME
steps.instruction: Press HOME (the confirmation appears: I accept homing under load → Home).
steps.expected: the table drives to START, backs off, HOMED green
steps.safety: Unexpected motion → observer presses the red E-stop at once (independent D-42 path); operator releases any jog button and presses STOP; STOP, report.

steps.title: Homed move check
steps.instruction: Zero the caliper, +10 (Steps) → read the caliper; then Go to absolute 20 mm (speed 5 mm/s).
steps.safety: Unexpected motion → observer presses the red E-stop at once (independent D-42 path); operator releases any jog button and presses STOP; STOP, report.

steps.title: END switch stop at low speed
steps.instruction: Go to absolute 280 mm (5 mm/s). Untick Driver enabled (Specimen is unloaded → Disable), hands off, tick it again (un-homed now). Jog (+) at 1 mm/s to the END switch; a further (+) jog must be refused; jog (−) away.
steps.expected: stops at once, LIM E red; (+) refused; (−) clears it (the stop must end the jog: EVENT STOPPED LIMIT_END)
steps.safety: Unexpected motion → observer presses the red E-stop at once (independent D-42 path); operator releases any jog button and presses STOP; STOP, report. Hands off the shaft before the E-stop / RESET is released and before any Clear / ENABLE (the closed-loop driver re-energises at once).

all.label: jog stopped by the END switch

steps.title: HOME again
steps.instruction: Press HOME again; keep the no-specimen mode on for section 10.

steps.title: Fit the ENA shunt
steps.instruction: Everything off: 100 Ω 1 % shunt in series with ENA− (driver ENA− terminal → logic GND). Label it. The DIR shunt comes in 10.1.3 — never both while the motor is powered.
steps.safety: Wiring change only with the PSU off and the USB unplugged.

steps.title: USB only, 48 V off
steps.instruction: USB in, Connect; the 48 V stays OFF for the ENA reading.

steps.title: I_LED on ENA (48 V off)
steps.instruction: Press and release the red E-stop → Clear stop… → Clear E-STOP (ENA held disabled by the MCU, SAF-FW-006). DMM across the ENA shunt. Then everything off: remove the ENA shunt, fit the DIR shunt.
steps.expected: ≥ 0.60 V (I_LED ≥ 6 mA), or 0.45…0.60 V → low-burden repeat in 10.1.5; below 0.45 V → FAIL: buffer board required (SYS-011, D-56 b)

all.label: ENA output at the disabled level

fields.name: swapped
fields.label: ENA shunt removed, DIR shunt fitted (everything off)

steps.safety: Wiring change only with the PSU off and the USB unplugged.

steps.title: I_LED on DIR (48 V on)
steps.instruction: USB in, Connect, observer switches the 48 V on; re-enter no-specimen mode (as 9.1); Driver enabled (hands off); table mid-stroke ≥ 20 mm from both switches. Jog (+) for ≈ 1 s (dir_invert = 1: (−)), release; DMM across the DIR shunt; a short jog the other way → ≈ 0 V.
steps.expected: ≥ 0.60 V (I_LED ≥ 6 mA), or 0.45…0.60 V → low-burden repeat in 10.1.5; ≈ 0 V after the opposite jog; below 0.45 V → FAIL: buffer board required (SYS-011, D-56 b)
steps.safety: Unexpected motion → observer presses the red E-stop at once (independent D-42 path); operator releases any jog button and presses STOP; STOP, report.

all.label: jog done since the step was selected

steps.title: Low-burden repeat decision
steps.instruction: If 10.1.3 or 10.1.4 read 0.45…0.60 V: repeat that input with the DMM mA range in series (burden ≤ 10 Ω) or a 10 Ω shunt (≥ 60 mV); that reading decides. Otherwise choose 'all readings ≥ 0.60 V'.
steps.expected: all readings ≥ 0.60 V, or the repeated readings ≥ 6 mA; below 6 mA → FAIL: buffer board required (SYS-011, D-56 b)

invalid_when.text: a 10.1.3 / 10.1.4 reading is below 0.60 V (or missing) — repeat it with the mA range / 10 Ω shunt

steps.safety: Below 6 mA → STOP: buffer board required (D-56 b).

steps.title: Restore DIR− and ENA−
steps.instruction: Everything off, remove the DIR shunt, DIR− and ENA− back to logic GND; photo.
steps.safety: Wiring change only with the PSU off and the USB unplugged.

steps.title: Ready for the pulse-integrity check
steps.instruction: USB / 48 V on; re-enter no-specimen mode (as 9.1); Driver enabled; HOME (as 9.6) — the 10.1 power cycles left the axis un-homed and ended the mode; 9.5 and 9.8 passed today.
steps.safety: Full travel speed: no specimen, nothing in the travel, the observer's hand at the red E-stop.

steps.title: Pulse-integrity check (SYS-011)
steps.instruction: Axis homed, Driver enabled, no-specimen mode on, nothing in the travel, the observer's hand at the red E-stop. Press 'Run pulse-integrity check': 3 baseline re-homes of the homed axis, 10 round trips 5 ↔ 285 mm at 30 mm/s, final re-home; one repeat allowed.
steps.expected: no HOME_DRIFT and |d1| ≤ max(30 µm, 2 · max|d0ᵢ|)
steps.hg: SYS-011 (D-56 b); related HG-09, HG-25 / HG-26 (not gate evidence)
steps.safety: Full travel speed: no specimen, nothing in the travel, the observer's hand at the red E-stop.

params.fail_text: buffer board required (SYS-011, D-56 b) — report to the PO
params.baseline_fail_text: check the START switch mounting (switch repeatability, not a buffer verdict)

steps.title: Moves (part of 10.2.2)
steps.instruction: In the assistant the 20 moves are run by 10.2.2 (paper: Sequence 285 / 5 mm × 10 at 30 mm/s). An E_RANGE 'speed above cap' / 'loaded' → STOP, record Raw, never raise a cap. This step only shows 10.2.2's verdict.
steps.expected: follows 10.2.2: 20 moves done in the engine run

steps.title: Re-home result (part of 10.2.2)
steps.instruction: After 10.2.2: shows its verdict; no HOME_DRIFT latched, axis homed.

steps.title: Repeat rule (part of 10.2.2)
steps.instruction: One repeat is allowed (run 10.2.2 again from the baseline); a second fail → STOP: buffer board required — report to the PO. This step only shows 10.2.2's verdict.
steps.expected: follows 10.2.2 (one repeat allowed, then buffer verdict)

steps.title: Repeat in future
steps.instruction: Repeat this check after any wiring change and at the end of every test campaign (SYS-011).

steps.title: Leave no-specimen mode
steps.instruction: Banner or Safety limits tab → Leave no-specimen mode.

steps.title: Travel calibration wizard
steps.instruction: Calibration & Tare → Start travel calibration wizard… → Start → 'Start calibration': tick No specimen is mounted → Start (homes first if needed) → follow the wizard to Accept.
steps.safety: No specimen. The wizard moves the axis.

steps.title: Wizard distances
steps.instruction: Measured distance D1 (after Move 10 mm) and Total distance D_tot (after Move 50 mm).

steps.title: Travel calibration result
steps.instruction: Accepted steps/mm (spm2) and the chain spm0 → spm1 → spm2. A value near 160 → DIP SW1–SW4 → STOP. Re-home afterwards.

steps.title: PAUSED before the load wizard
steps.instruction: Before starting the wizard: the observer presses PAUSE once (PAUSED BUTTON). Do not press it again during 11.2 / 11.3; a pause inside a running wizard aborts it.
steps.safety: Hands in the load path only while PAUSED is shown.

steps.title: Weights only while PAUSED
steps.instruction: Hang / remove weights only while PAUSED is shown.

steps.title: Load calibration wizard
steps.instruction: Calibration & Tare → Start load calibration wizard… → Start; zero, 1 kg, 10 kg (11.2.4–11.2.6) → Accept calibration.
steps.safety: Keep PAUSED; do not press PAUSE again.

steps.title: Zero point
steps.instruction: Nothing on the cell, empty hook → Capture zero point ▶ (do not touch the stand).

steps.title: Weight points
steps.instruction: 1 kg hanging still → Capture point 1 ▶; 10 kg → Capture point 2 ▶ ('weight not detected' → hang freely, Repeat).
steps.safety: Hands in the load path only while PAUSED is shown.

steps.title: Fit result
steps.instruction: Fit page: status, K; the dialog 'K implausible — accept anyway?' must not appear.

steps.title: Weights removed
steps.instruction: Remove the weights (still PAUSED).
steps.safety: Hands in the load path only while PAUSED is shown.

steps.title: Tare
steps.instruction: Cell unloaded, axis still ≥ 1 s → TARE.
steps.expected: TARE chip green (with its age), THR VERIFIED

steps.title: Force check with 10 kg
steps.instruction: Hang the 10 kg weight again and read Force; remove it.
steps.safety: Hands in the load path only while PAUSED is shown.

steps.title: Resume
steps.instruction: Hands out of the load path → ▶ Resume (toolbar).

steps.title: Save to NVM
steps.instruction: Connection & Config → Save to NVM.
steps.expected: CFG green clean; the default-parameters notice is gone

steps.title: Save to file
steps.instruction: Save to file… → board_<UID>_<date>.bbboard.json (restores the configuration after an accidental wipe).

steps.title: Restart
steps.instruction: Untick Driver enabled (Specimen is unloaded → Disable), 48 V off (ALM red again), Disconnect, unplug the USB for 5 s, plug in, Connect.

fields.name: usb_cycled
fields.label: USB unplugged for 5 s and reconnected

steps.title: Verify after restart
steps.instruction: Connect, Read all.
